notes: Live LINK perp position panel (ticker OCR'd as 'LINKAUSO', i.e. LINK-USD) at 6.88x Long, plus two Ace messages. RESOLVES AN EARLIER PUZZLE: Ace states 'btc is down 57% {126k - 60k}', which explains why the IMG_7791/7792 BTC levels sit in the $60-74k band — this is a post-crash regime, not stale data. BUT HIS ARITHMETIC IS WRONG: 126k to 60k is a 52.4% decline, not 57%. Flag for the accuracy profile. LIQUIDATION PRICE is printed as '87.5635', which is impossible for a 6.88x LONG entered near $8.79 (liq must sit BELOW entry; 8.7933*(1-1/6.88) = 7.52). Almost certainly '7.5635' with a spurious leading digit from OCR — recorded verbatim, NOT corrected, needs visual confirmation. COLLATERAL is internally inconsistent as OCR'd: '$145.520 94 (14527.25 USDC)' — the dollar figure and the USDC figure differ by ~10x, so one is misread; needs visual. Cannot tell which of $8.7933 / $8.7001 is entry vs mark. NOTE THE STAKE: this panel shows a ~$1.0M notional LINK long against ~$145k collateral, consistent with the '$1,000,814.99' and with the 'million dollar 6x lv position opened on link' claimed in IMG_7794 (leverage there stated as 6x, here 6.88x). The 03/03 02:03 message is a self-declared vindication ('the market confirmed') posted ~19h after the 02/03 07:21 call — worth checking against actual price action. Second message is a reply quoting the first.
